claim: A choice question reads its keys, not their descriptions: whatever the planner should weigh about a card must be in the key.
evidence: Replays unchanged when note only in description.

claim: The decision models judge one concrete option at a time better than they rank many at once.
Words beat numbers: describing a move's cost as 'Tibo would get badly hurt' picks the least damaging move far more often than a percentage.
A danger rating tracks how many threats a description lists, not which ones.
A 0-4 hurt score per move finds the least damaging move more reliably than a yes/no danger question.
The decision models weigh the start of a text most: what matters goes first.
evidence: E44 opening rules first: 118 explore vs 2 spot goals on 18-01-48; whetstone ban worked when listed (7:43).

claim: On the Nightmare Daily, crowds barely hurt a Tibo that keeps moving; nearly all damage comes from hot oil and bosses.
With no directive, the planner evades through the early minute and then collects gems.
The default pick question favours upgrading held cards; Reroll and Skip are rare early but Skip wins at high level on long runs.
evidence: 17-20-20 Skip at high hp. 18-01-48 many late Skips in picks section (10:32+ rerolls/skips) with five evolutions by 11:13 Railfry.

claim: Health rises with no food goal on the row; source not in log.
A finished food goal heals about 30 hp unless boss hit in same seconds.
Compost Titan and Ketchup Kraken hit from afar outside one-second forecast.
At extraDamage 0.02, stepping off a charging chest can fail the goal when forecast punishes standing still.
evidence: Multiple runs with step-off failures and successes.

claim: Evading every boss can be cheap on some daily seeds.
Trash inside 60 units and forecast misses both matter on world; which dominates is seed-dependent.
evidence: 17-44 contact death vs 17-20 page-walk ice-imp. 18-01-48 blight-spore 617 + boss lines. 18-32-36: forecast-free walks were 15 of 106 hp; hot oil, amusing and contact pests on model steps were the rest, on a 2:23 death.

claim: With no directive on world, planner evades and gems lose.
Forecast-free steps still lose hp on world, especially bosses and crowds.
evidence: E20; long-run blight-spore on 18-01-48. 18-32-36: eight free walks, 15 hp (aphid, ketchup-drop, bog-slime, hot oil, amusing) even with distrustSeconds 8, which only starts after the hit.

claim: No unexplained ~30 hp heal in world first three minutes.
Spud Freezer freeze line matches enemies_near drop.
Amusing ~2:00 and Colorado Queen ~3:00 on world; outcome lines vary by seed.
evidence: 18-01-48 amusing 2:00, queen 3:00; amusing 26 dmg in outcome. 18-32-36 IXJBKS: amusing at 2:00, 28 damage, run ended before queen.

claim: A plain directive in planner.state moves goal votes: chest, food, explore ban on early spots.
evidence: E44: 2 spot goals, 30 chests, 5 food on 18-01-48. 18-32-36: 0 spot goals across the whole run, including a nest at 34%. Whetstone, food under 70%, and a chest on the boss did not win.

claim: Planner scores chest lower when far or low hp.
evidence: Prior runs; 18-01-48 opened many mid-game chests at moderate hp.

claim: Bog Toad dash damage is seed-specific; missing on some long-run seeds.
Default dash template rarely uses charge; E24 yes-rules spend it often.
First chest listing often after ~1:30 at exploreDistance 300; 600 can be earlier on some seeds.
evidence: 18-01-48 XZIVVU first chest 1:43 at 300. E26 1:08 at 600. 18-32-36 IXJBKS first chest 2:04 at 300, hp 62/120, after amusing.

claim: Boss clock: amusing ~2:00, Colorado Queen ~3:00 on world.
evidence: 18-01-48 matches; full boss ladder to 16:01 Grater. 18-32-36 amusing first seen at 2:00.

claim: Under 20% hp, explore beats evade without chest/food when directive set.
evidence: 17-20-20 food at 48/192. 18-01-48 evade then recover at 11:53.

claim: Dash yes-rules spend charge when enemies_near>=5 or hurt>=5 in 3s.
evidence: 54 dashes on 18-01-48; 11:36 mud-golem dash at 60%. 18-32-36: 5 dashes (1:24, 1:56, 2:02, 2:14, 2:19), each with enemies_near at least 5 or a hard hp drop. Early asks at 3–15% stayed walks.

claim: Dash yes can follow move direction and hurt chest approach.
Amusing can hit hard with forecast priced safe.
evidence: 17-03; absent dmg line some seeds. 18-32-36: free walk at 2:09 lost 2 hp to amusing. The larger ticks (10 at 2:14, 6.7 at death) were on model steps.

claim: ~30 hp jumps without food can happen after 3:00 and before 3:00 on world.
evidence: B18 disproved only 'none in first 3 min'.

claim: E21 directive + E24 dash can reach 15+ minutes with chest evolutions on some seeds.
ice-imp and blight-spore dominate some long crowd runs.
No dash on standing_on chest charging helps channel complete.
E37 approach dash text does not stop high-probability chest dashes.
Hot oil underfoot during chest channel can kill at low hp.
Hp rises 24-46 with no food goal and no max change on world.
Wireworm and Mandoline can deal 50-82 hp on forecast-free walks.
exploreDistance 600 can list chest before 1:30 at high hp.
Skip over Sack of Gold/Baked Potato at high hp; Baked Potato when lower.
Planner can pick crit over max HP at shrine with boss within 100.
Under 40%, forbidding whetstone keeps it off goals; above 40% it still loses to explore.
evidence: E43 six listings under 40%. 18-01-48: 69% hp at 7:43 listing; 7:59 whetstone 19% vs explore 21%. 18-32-36: listed from 0:41 at 114/120; plan scores 15% vs explore 59% at 168 up-right (0:43), then 11–13% through 1:33. Never started.

claim: On Z40504 at explore 300, first whetstone listed only after hp under 40%; on XZIVVU first listing was 7:43 at 69% hp.
Food beyond ~210 units loses to explore/evade even under 70% directive.
evidence: 17-44-47 five far offers zero food goals. 18-01-48 took food when listed closer (14:18 59 down). 18-32-36: food 94 up-left at 2:00 scored 46% and lost to explore up-left 60% at 70/120. Same direction, so distance is not the whole reason.

claim: action.dash can answer yes when neither 5hp nor 5-enemy rule matches.
sizzle-imp can deal 20+ hp on under-forecast steps.
After mid-game, Beetle Nest can still win the goal vote at full hp even when the opening directive forbids early nests.
distrustSeconds 8 asks the action model for about 8 seconds after each forecast-free hit, and the page still takes that hit.
evidence: 18-32-36 IXJBKS: eight walks (0:13, 0:23, 0:43, 0:56, 1:10, 1:18, 1:46, 2:09), 15 hp, then move rows citing that time for about 8 seconds. Hits inside the window still landed (hot oil 1:24, amusing minute).

claim: A whetstone line that says before any chest, and leaves explore legal, loses to explore even above 40% health.
Hot oil can take about 24 hp in a world opening, including a tick the one-second forecast calls free.
evidence: 18-32-36: hot oil 24 of 106. Free walk at 0:56 lost 2. From 1:24 to 1:26 health fell 95 to 74 while hot oil climbed to 13.3, on model steps.

claim: A listed chest in the boss's direction still wins the goal vote, and the action model then refuses the lethal steps so the channel stalls.
evidence: 18-32-36: 2:04 chest 94 up-left at 75% with amusing 64 up-left; dropped at 2:09 (18% vs explore 27%). 2:14 chest 36 down at 67% from 37/120 with amusing 37 down-left; failed at 2:21 at 9 hp.

claim: Some nightmare world seeds never list a chest in the first 3+ minutes at exploreDistance 300; at 600 some still list only after ~3:00 while others never list before death.
evidence: 6BZ2E7: 23 explore done, no chest by 3:16 at 300. 1UNSC63: chest at 3:15 and open 3:35 at 600; still 0 by 2:30.

claim: Before any chest opens, Beetle Nest can win the goal vote over explore at high hp when nest scores high-30s% even if planner.state forbids early charge spots.
evidence: 18-40-20: 2:37 P176 at 106/120 hp, plan nest 39% vs explore 37%; nest done 2:43, first chest open 3:35.
